offerings.summary: A women's circle held on each full moon — sharing, sound, breath and ceremony by candlelight.
offerings.name: Woman's Full Moon Circle
description: A gentle, women-only gathering held on each full moon. We sit in a circle by candlelight to slow down, share what we are carrying, and mark the turn of the month together.
Each circle weaves together breath, meditation and sound, with space to simply be heard. No experience is needed and you are welcome to come alone — you will not be alone once you arrive.
R200 per person. Places are limited so the circle stays intimate. Choose a full-moon date on the schedule and we will reply with everything you need, including how to pay to hold your place.

offerings.summary: An immersive guided breathing journey in a small group.
offerings.name: Breathwork Group Class
description: A guided group class using conscious connected breathing, carried by immersive sound. The breath is the whole technique — no experience is needed, only willingness.
Held in the Oasis Studio with the doors open to the valley, every second Wednesday. Bring water and wear something warm for the rest at the end.
R400 per person. Limited to 8 places. Choose a date on the schedule and we will reply with everything you need, including how to pay to hold your place.

offerings.summary: The Oasis Studio, a timber space among the trees, available to teachers, practitioners and facilitators.
offerings.name: Oasis Studio Hire
description: A quiet, light-filled space for your own classes, workshops, retreats and gatherings. Warm timber floors and walls, with glass doors that open onto the garden and forest.
The Oasis Studio comfortably holds a small group. Mats, bolsters and blocks are available, and there is parking on site and a kitchenette for tea.
Tell us what you are planning and we will find the hours that work.

offerings.summary: A full forty minutes in the infrared sauna, looking into the trees.
offerings.name: Sauna (40 min, Infrared)
description: Infrared heat works at a lower air temperature than a traditional sauna, so you can stay in longer and go deeper. Forty minutes is enough to properly unwind.
Towels provided. Arrive a few minutes early to settle.

offerings.summary: A shorter infrared session, ideal after a trail run or a class.
offerings.name: Sauna (20 min, Infrared)
description: Twenty minutes of infrared heat, perfect on its own or straight after a walk on the mountain.

offerings.summary: A monthly gathering for women under the full moon, sharing, ritual and stillness in the Oasis Studio.
offerings.name: Women's Full Moon Circle
description: Held on the night of the full moon, this circle brings women together to sit, share and release under one roof and one sky. Expect a guided opening, space to speak or simply listen, and a closing ritual with candlelight and sound.

No experience or belief required, only an open heart. Everyone is encouraged to bring something for the harvest table to share. Numbers are kept small so everyone is heard. Apply below and we will confirm your place ahead of the next moon.
